holdout.split: SHA256(project_id), fixed salt; modulo 5 == 0 held out

materialHoldout.split: supplier_name SHA256 fixed salt; same supplier never in both partitions
materialHoldout.interpretation: Not independent: all covered test rows reproduce a training price for the same feature key; do not interpret zero error as predictive accuracy

provenanceEvidence.boq: generateBOQItems uses category basePrice x city.costIndex x random jitter and random quantities
provenanceEvidence.material: generateMaterialPrices repeats one jittered material/city price across supplier records
provenanceEvidence.interpretation: Dataset patterns match the included synthetic generator; no independently verified project or market evidence supplied

limitations: CSV provenance and prices are unverified; not current market quotes
Project-ID separation is not independent real-world validation; generator/template leakage has not been excluded
No measured ground-truth quantities or actual final project costs
BOQ quantities and staffing/duration/overheads remain engineering heuristics
Installed BOQ rates may already include labor/equipment: cost scope needs review
Confidence is not empirically calibrated; no production approval
